title.en: Why I built a tool to explain my CAD model
title.ja: CADモデルを説明するツールを作った理由

prompt: What problem did you hit? What did you try first? What does the tool do now, and what would you tell someone about to build something similar? (Keep the humility from your post.)

title.en: Designing for the customer, not for completeness
title.ja: 網羅性ではなく、利用者のための設計

prompt: What did you first build, what did the customer actually need, and what changed? Do not name the business or show its data.

title.en: The textbook boost converter vs the real one
title.ja: 教科書の昇圧回路と実際の昇圧回路

prompt: What surprised you reading the datasheet? What did the failed breadboard teach you about layout?

title.ja: デバッグこそがプロジェクトのすべて

prompt: Pick one bug from the 8-bit computer (loose wire seen on the phone camera, RAM, display multiplexing, the 2 AM substitution). What did you do, and what would you do differently?
The 360-degree servos and the one loose ground pin on RoboDog: what did you assume, what was true, how did you find it?

title.ja: ロボサッカーに花火を持ち込んだ話

prompt: What happened to the motor driver, what did the 5 kg rulebook teach you, and what changed in the second attempt? State the result honestly.

title.en: Half-asleep yes to a second place
title.ja: 寝ぼけて引き受けた準優勝

prompt: How did the InnovateX 2025 team (Code Slayers) form, what did you build, and what did the result teach you?

title.en: From the software route to robotics
title.ja: ソフトウェアの道からロボティクスへ

prompt: Why did you choose robotics after a year of software preparation? (Keep pay out of it, per your decision.)
